predecessors.name: Mauro-Roman Kingdom
predecessors.text: the 'rump state of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom' left around Altava after Garmul's defeat in 578; 'significantly smaller in size'

successors.name: Umayyad Caliphate
successors.text: Altava and its surroundings, 'Annexed by Umayyad Caliphate: 708' (infobox)

ledger.x: 578: the Mauro-Roman Kingdom collapses and Altava remains.
c.678-690: under Aksel (Kusaila) the kingdom reaches from Volubilis to the Aures.
683: Uqba dies at Vescera and the Arabs leave Kairouan.
688: Zuhayr ibn Qays marches against Kusaila.
690: Kusaila falls at the Battle of Mamma.
690: Kusaila's realm falls apart after Mamma.

wars.name: Battle of Vescera
wars.outcome: Kusaila ambushed and killed Uqba ibn Nafi near Biskra and 'forced the Arabs to leave Kairouan', which he held until its recapture in 688.

wars.name: Battle of Mamma and the Arab reconquest of Ifriqiya
wars.outcome: Zuhayr ibn Qays recaptured Kairouan in 688 and defeated a combined Berber and Byzantine army at Mamma in 690, killing Kusaila.

wars.name: Umayyad conquest of the Maghreb (Altava)
wars.outcome: Altava is 'Annexed by Umayyad Caliphate: 708' (infobox); the Muslim conquest page has Tangier garrisoned in 708 and the last Byzantine strongholds lost in 709.

certainty.note: A Berber-Roman kingdom of the Algerian highlands: no page gives a frontier; the 678-690 extent 'from Volubilis to the Aures' is a line between two named places.
